Messages.Author: TONY RICARDI
Messages.Body:
I, genius that I am, discovered a nasty combo last night using
Heidelburg Castle. I put Fame on a vamp, and bled my prey. He blocked.
After he declared block, but before combat, I tapped Heidelburg to move
all blood from the Famous vamp to another. Torporville! My prey was
not amused, since he had only 3 pool...

Messages.Body:



Your opponents, fools that they are, let you get away with a blatantly
illegal move, according to the text _written on the card_...

UNIQUE LOCATION. Tap to transfer equipment cards, move blood, and
transfer retainers between any two ready vampires you control (you may
choose the amount of blood you move and which cards you transfer).

Equipment, blood, retainers - not masters. Card text does not allow for
moving of masters... including Fame.

Nice try... no cigar. :-)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
dsa...@prism.gatech.edu (Stuart J. Pieloch) writes:
>I tried this also, however, my illustrious opposing meth pulled a pulled fangs
>out of his butt and POOF went the Famous Vamp.

>Sometimes great card combos can backfire.

It only backfired because of an inappropriate circumvention of the
timing rules for Pulled Fangs and Torpor:

The opposing vampire cannot pull fangs unless he inflicts more damage
than you do. This implies that he inflicts at least one damage which
remins unprevented. One damage to an empty vampire will send it to
torpor immediately after strike resolution (before the press step).

Since Pulled Fangs can only be used during the press step, it cannot
be played in this case. The Famous one goes to torpor.
--
